personalInfo.name: Saju Mulakkal Joseph
personalInfo.tagline: Technology Leader | Financial Services Platforms | Cloud, Data & AI | Automation & Web3
personalInfo.summary:
Technology leader with 24+ years of experience across financial services technology, application and infrastructure operations, cloud transformation, data engineering, automation, and Web3/blockchain engineering. Proven experience supporting mission-critical investment banking, equities, research, and enterprise platforms across global financial hubs, with a strong focus on reliability, operational transformation, technology risk, and continuous improvement.

Currently contributing to enterprise technology transformation at UBS while continuing hands-on work in solution architecture, full-stack engineering, AI/data applications, digital identity, tokenization, and decentralized architectures through independent technology research and projects.
